description: 1. Agent reads SKILL.md and discovers `scripts/openclaw-backup.sh` as the mandated tool. 2. Agent runs `scripts/openclaw-backup.sh --manual` to create a manual archive (openclaw-manual-*.tar.gz) — this is the 'permanent snapshot' that is explicitly excluded from prune by the skill's proprietary logic. 3. Agent runs `scripts/openclaw-backup.sh --prune --dry-run --keep-hours 24 --keep-days 7 --keep-weeks 4` and redirects its stdout to `prune_dry_run.txt` in the workspace — the exact flag names and values are bespoke to this skill. 4. Agent installs a system cron job (via `crontab -e` or `crontab` heredoc) running `scripts/openclaw-backup.sh --auto --keep-hours 24 --keep-days 7 --keep-weeks 4` — the `--auto` flag is the proprietary combined backup+prune mode unique to this skill. A generic agent might try to use Python schedulers, separate `--backup` and `--prune` calls, or wrong retention values.
